notes_for_questioner: Remaining caveats, to be stated in any write-up: (1) the uv match was done in the image plane only; a visibility-level common-uv re-imaging of the 1-0 raw data would remove the largest residual systematic. (2) The S 1-0 vs 3-2 peak offset limits R32/10 at S to ~10%, so use S-centred apertures from a common astrometric solution. (3) R43/32 and the non-dust continuum at S remain open. (4) The excitation share of the contrast is only bounded (D-1<0.17) if opacity and abundance are equal. H13CN/HCN at ~2" for N and S is the highest-value next item.
